This unique composition distinguishes it from other dermal fillers that typically use hyaluronic acid. The CaHA microspheres are suspended in a gel carrier, providing immediate facial volume and improved skin texture. Collagen Stimulation By stimulating your body’s collagen production, Radiesse® restores lost volume, improves skin texture, firmness, and elasticity, for a comprehensive approach to facial rejuvenation. Collagen Biostimulators in Nashua, NH Unlike traditional fillers that provide immediate results, Radiesse® stimulates your body’s own collagen production over time. This leads to a gradual, natural-looking improvement in facial volume and reduced wrinkles and folds. As new collagen forms, it gradually fills in wrinkles and adds fullness to areas that have lost volume, such as the cheeks and temples. Results develop progressively, typically over several months, providing a natural and long-lasting enhancement. Book an appointment Common Questions About Collagen Biostimulators How many Collagen Biostimulators treatments will I need? The number of treatments required varies based on your individual goals and the areas being treated. Typically, a series of 2-3 sessions spaced several weeks apart is recommended for optimal results. When will I see results from Collagen Biostimulators? Collagen Biostimulator results develop gradually over several months as your body produces new collagen. Initial improvements may be seen after a few weeks, with more significant results appearing over time. Are Collagen Biostimulators painful? Most patients experience minimal discomfort during the treatment and describe only feeling a slight pinch during the treatment. A numbing cream can be applied beforehand to ensure you’re as comfortable as possible throughout the treatment process. How long do Collagen Biostimulator results last? Collagen Biostimulator results can last up to two years or more, depending on individual factors and the areas treated. Regular follow-up treatments can help maintain your desired look. What is the downtime after Collagen Biostimulator treatment? Downtime is minimal. You may experience mild redness, swel li ng, or bruising, which typically resolves within a few days. Most patients can resume their daily activities right away. Are there any side effects of Collagen Biostimulator injections? Side effects are generally mild and may include temporary swel li ng, redness, or bruising at the injection sites. These effects a re usually short-lived and resolve on their own.
